source: v2 (randomization_ranges_v2.json) widened to the real SO-101 measurements of 2026-11-26/27 (so101_rl/sim2real_capture.py sessions 20261126-211901 and -221411, calib_poses, height_check).

rationale.camera: overhead refit residual ~1 cm / ~1-2 deg; wrist mount fit ~8 mm / ~1 deg off CAD (v2: 5 mm / 1-2 deg)
rationale.appearance: real overhead ~0.81x and wrist ~0.67x the sim brightness, wrist contrast ~0.5x; per-camera draws
rationale.servo_gains: per-joint kp/kv scales fitted to real 8-deg step responses (pan/lift/flex rms 0.15-0.20 deg vs 1.2 deg at default gains; real 90% rise 6-10 steps vs 3 in sim, no overshoot); x/1.5 spread
rationale.servo_deadband: median |measured - commanded| over 19 real holding poses (pan .3 .. elbow 2.8 deg), constant across poses with different gravity load, i.e. friction against the low-gain servo, not sag; drawn U(0, 1.5) x this
rationale.calibration: joint offsets are known to ~2-3 deg (roll ~3); lift and elbow trade off along (+1, -1) with ~1 cm fingertip height at full reach, which the image and height checks could not separate
